name: San Salvo (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Salvo (a wheat sheaf on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of San Salvo, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Salvo arms — wheat sheaf on blue, crowned, within branches
